# Data

**All data in this folder is synthetic.** Generated by
`../src/generate_data.py`, seeded with `random_state=42`, so re-running the
script reproduces these exact files. No real company, customer, product, or
transaction is represented — names, cities, prices, and purchase patterns are
randomly generated.

Total size: ~0.8 MB (well under the 2 MB budget).

## Schema

### `orders.csv` — 12,000 rows (2023-01-01 → 2024-12-31)

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | string | Unique order id (`O100000`–`O111999`) |
| `order_date` | date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) | Order date, sampled with seasonality (Nov/Dec spike, summer bump, slow February) |
| `customer_id` | string | FK → `customers.customer_id` |
| `product_id` | string | FK → `products.product_id` |
| `quantity` | int | Units in the order line (1–5) |
| `unit_price` | float | Unit price in USD (±3% promo noise vs catalog price) |
| `discount` | float | Line discount rate (0.00, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20) |
| `line_total` | float | `unit_price × quantity × (1 − discount)`, rounded to cents |
| `channel` | string | `Online` (45%), `In-Store` (35%), `Mobile App` (20%) |

### `customers.csv` — 2,500 rows

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | string | Unique customer id (`C1000`–`C3499`) |
| `customer_name` | string | Randomly generated fictional name |
| `region` | string | `North`, `South`, `East`, `West` |
| `city` | string | Fictional assignment consistent with region |
| `signup_date` | date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) | Random date in 2021–2023 |

1,903 of the 2,500 customers placed at least one order in 2023–2024.

### `products.csv` — 60 rows

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | string | Unique product id (`P001`–`P060`) |
| `product_name` | string | Fictional product name (adjective + noun) |
| `category` | string | One of 6: `Electronics`, `Home & Kitchen`, `Apparel`, `Sports`, `Beauty`, `Toys` |
| `unit_price` | float | Catalog unit price in USD (range varies by category) |

## Regenerating

```bash
python src/generate_data.py
```
